_comment: Two separate Crisp ACCOUNTS (different logins/billing), not just different inboxes under one account. Each top-level key here must exactly match the suffix used in that account's secrets/variable names: CRISP_<KEY>_IDENTIFIER, CRISP_<KEY>_KEY (both secrets), CRISP_<KEY>_WEBSITE_ID (a variable, not a secret).
_format: accounts.<ACCOUNT_KEY> = { "repo": "org/repo" } for a single-product account (everything from this account goes to one repo, no inbox lookup needed), OR { "inboxes": { "<inbox_id>": { "repo": "org/repo" } } } once one account genuinely serves multiple products needing different repos.
